blocks.html: TAK Tracker can send and receive text messages with everyone on the server — ATAK, WinTAK and other TAK Tracker users alike.

slides.title: Open Chat and send a message
slides.html: Tap Chat on the toolbar to open the messaging window, type your message and send it. Anyone enrolled on the same server can read it and reply.

slides.title: Spot unread messages
slides.html: The Chat icon shows the number of unread messages in red. Tap it to open the conversation and clear the count.
